summary: Iteration 3 — Phase 4 UI (Reports, Novelties, Team) + PWA prompt. Backend regression: 49/49 pytest cases pass (41 existing + 8 new for Phase 4 endpoints). Frontend E2E: Reports filters/stats/export, Novelties create/bulk-approve/individual-reject/delete, Team matrix + KPIs + days selector, PWA + employee role restrictions — all verified. One bug found: admin sidebar is missing a link to /equipo (Team page).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin sidebar has NO link to /equipo (nav-equipo missing). The Team route is protected by ADMIN_OR_SUP so admin CAN access it, but there is no way to navigate via sidebar — user has to type URL manually. NAV_SUPERVISOR includes /equipo but NAV_ADMIN skips it.

issues: Benign ResizeObserver-loop warnings from Radix UI (Select/Dialog) trigger the CRA dev error overlay. In production this overlay does not exist and users won't see it. Consider suppressing this specific warning globally via `window.addEventListener('error', e => { if(/ResizeObserver loop/.test(e.message)) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true)` so dev experience is cleaner.

action_items: Add `{ to: '/equipo', icon: Users, label: 'Mi equipo' }` to NAV_ADMIN in /app/frontend/src/components/AppLayout.jsx so admin can navigate to Team page via sidebar (data-testid `nav-equipo`).
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx: NAV_ADMIN missing /equipo entry — inconsistent with route protection which allows admin (ADMIN_OR_SUP).

ReportsPage.jsx line 64: fetchReports() sends only from_date/to_date/user_id/site_id — filters `type` and `status` are client-side only. Fine for correctness but the CSV export ignores type/status filters entirely (only date range). Consider passing them to the export endpoint or documenting that CSV = raw dataset.
InstallPWAPrompt.jsx: no cleanup for the 'appinstalled' listener (only 'beforeinstallprompt' is cleaned in the return). Minor memory-leak footgun on hot-reload.

NoveltiesPage.jsx: TypeError-prone if `user?.user_id` is undefined when isManager creates for someone else — Select default is `form.user_id || user?.user_id`, works but sends user_id only if isManager. OK, but empty user_id is stripped before POST so payload doesn't 400. Consider more explicit handling.
TeamPage.jsx line 32-104: heavy useMemo chain re-computes matrix on every teamRecords change. Acceptable for 17 users × 30 days, but could be slower for 100+ users.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical Phase 4 flows verified; only issue is missing admin sidebar link to /equipo)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 UI fully functional: /reportes has 6 working filters (from/to/user/site/type/status) + CSV export with Content-Disposition header + KPIs computed client-side over filtered set; /novedades supports create (with future dates), bulk approve/reject via sticky bulk-bar, individual approve/reject via decide-dialog, employee-scoped delete of pending; /equipo shows day×employee matrix (17 rows for admin excluding admins) + 4 KPIs + configurable days range (1/3/7/14/30). PWA prompt (InstallPWAPrompt.jsx) is silent in headless (no beforeinstallprompt) and doesn't break anything. IMPORTANT open item: admin has NO sidebar entry for /equipo (NAV_ADMIN missing it). Employee correctly locked out of /reportes and /equipo (redirects to /historial) and cannot see nav-usuarios/nav-reportes/nav-equipo. Backend 100% (49/49) including 8 new Phase 4 endpoint tests.
rca of the issue: Missing nav-equipo for admin: root cause is in /app/frontend/src/components/AppLayout.jsx lines 14-23 (NAV_ADMIN). NAV_SUPERVISOR includes { to: '/equipo', icon: Users, label: 'Mi equipo' } but NAV_ADMIN omits it. Fix: spread /equipo into NAV_ADMIN or refactor to compose from a base list. Reproduction: login as rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve/admin123 → look at left sidebar → note that Empleados/Sedes/Departamentos/Horarios/Reportes/Novedades/Ajustes are shown but 'Mi equipo' is not. Manually navigating to /equipo works because ProtectedRoute allows ADMIN_OR_SUP.
